name: Samsung Odyssey G7 LC27G75TQSRXEN (C27G75T)
A_response_avg: 2.9 ms avg G2G @240Hz z Adaptive-Sync ON, zakres 0.8–14.4 ms, 90% przejść nadąża za 240 Hz (tftcentral.co.uk/reviews/samsung_odyssey_g7_c27g75t); 2.84 ms avg @240Hz, ~3 ms @165/144/120/100Hz, ~4 ms @60Hz, >90% compliance (techspot.com/review/2059-samsung-odyssey-g7/) (wariant siostrzany: C32G75T)
A_dark_transitions: 0>50 = 14.4 ms (najwolniejsze), 'basically no dark smearing', 'very minor black smearing on darker backgrounds' (tftcentral); TechSpot: dark level 'mid-table, around the mark of a typical IPS', 'practically zero ghosting at 240Hz' po rozgrzaniu, wolniejszy na zimno 30–60 min; RTINGS: 'Fast-moving objects still have smearing' (wariant siostrzany: C32G75T)
A_overshoot: 'Low levels' overshoot (tftcentral); TechSpot: 'minimal overshoot' @240Hz, 'Fastest' bez VRR daje 'noticeable inverse ghosting'; brak % (wariant siostrzany: C32G75T)
A_best_overdrive: Adaptive-Sync ON (OD zablokowany na Standard, stałe wyniki 60–240 Hz); bez VRR: 'Faster' optymalny; 'Fastest' odradzany (tftcentral; techspot)
B_vrr_flicker: TFTCentral: 'some very slight brightness fluctuations on occasion'; firmware v1009.3 dodał 'VRR control'; RTINGS (firmware 1016.1): 'Noticeable VRR flicker with changing frame rates', 'distracting VRR flicker in dark scenes' (wariant siostrzany: C32G75T)
B_bfi: Tak — 'Fastest (MBR)' @240/144/120/60Hz, on-period 3 ms @240Hz, 'didn't really feel this mode offered any benefit' (tftcentral); TechSpot: strobing źle zsynchronizowany, tylko ~30% ekranu z akceptowalną redukcją rozmycia, podwójne obrazy w górnej połowie, nie działa z VRR
C_subpixel: BRAK (panel Samsung CY-PT270PLLV1H SVA, pixel pitch 0.233 mm) (tftcentral)
D_hdr_peak: 626 cd/m² peak HDR, 391 cd/m² max SDR (tftcentral); TechSpot: ~600 nit peak HDR, ~360 nit SDR po kalibracji (wariant siostrzany: C32G75T)
D_abl: BRAK; local dimming: 8 stref pionowych edge-lit, 'limited' (tftcentral); RTINGS: 'Terrible local dimming feature that causes blooming'
E_delta_e: TFTCentral: gamma 2.3 (Mode1)/2.23 (Mode2), punkt bieli 6535 K, gamut sRGB 123.0% / DCI-P3 90.7%, tryb sRGB = 114% sRGB (brak clampu); TechSpot: greyscale dE2000 avg 1.91, ColorChecker dE avg 16.46 vs sRGB (brak sRGB clamp) / 1.95 vs P3, P3 89%, kontrast 2000:1 (wariant siostrzany: C32G75T)
E_input_lag: 4.20 ms total (1.45 ms response + ~2.75 ms processing), 'Class 1' (tftcentral); RTINGS: 'Low input lag with VRR enabled' — liczba za paywallem
notes: TFTCentral = dokładny model 27" (24.08.2020). TechSpot i RTINGS testowały 32" C32G75T — RTINGS pisze 'the results are also valid for the 27-inch model'. TechSpot: kontrast 2000:1 (TFTCentral 2442:1 avg), wyraźny backlight bleed na egzemplarzu, pobór >50 W. RTINGS: 'many bugs' z VRR.
